origination.label: Creator
origination.corpname: John S. and James L. Knight Foundation

physdesc.extent: 17 letter document boxes and 1 flat document box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Records 10 years old and older are open for research with select materials restricted as noted.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Records are intellectually arranged in record groups by file type.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This accession primarily consists of program files and grant administration records, with select records documenting administrative functions, annual reports, awards, commissions and task forces, officers files, and other historical records.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Level 1: File-Level Access. Many records remain in original housing.

relatedmaterial.head: Related Materials
relatedmaterial.p: Memos to Trustees on Knight Foundation performance survey and Gallup Soul of the Community
